Package com.bookmap.addons.broadcasting.api.view

Interface BroadcasterConsumer

All Superinterfaces:
Broadcaster
public interface BroadcasterConsumer extends Broadcaster
A class for working with the library as a consumer. The consumer can connect to the addon provider. And then request its DataStructureInterface or subscribe to its live data and pass its listener to which the provider will send its events.

    • connectToProvider

      void connectToProvider(String providerAddonName, ConnectionStatusListener listener)
      Connect to the provider to work with it.
      Parameters:
      providerAddonName - - The full name of the provider addon with its package. It's better to take it from the getAvailableProviders() method. As an example "velox.indicators.absorption.AbsorptionIndicator".
      listener - - Your implementation of ConnectionStatusListener. Which will receive the appropriate flag to connect or disconnect from the provider.

    • subscribeToLiveData

      void subscribeToLiveData(String providerName, String generatorName, LiveEventListener liveEventListener, LiveConnectionStatusListener connectionListener)
      Trying to subscribe for the provider's live data. After a successful subscription, the status will be passed to connectionListener. After that, the provider will start live-streaming events to your liveEventListener.
      Parameters:
      providerName - - The full name of the provider addon with its package.
      generatorName - - Name of the provider's generator. You can get information about all generators from the getGeneratorsInfo method.
      liveEventListener - - The listener to which live events will be streamed.
      connectionListener - - The listener to which changes in live event subscription status will be received.

    • unsubscribeFromLiveData

      generatorName - - Name of the provider's generator.

    • setListenersForGenerator

      void setListenersForGenerator(String providerName, String generatorName, UpdateFilterListener filterListener, UpdateSettingsListener settingsListener)
      Sets your listeners to listen to filter updates and generator settings. You may need the filter if you want to filter events as well as the provider. Settings may be necessary if you want to know what settings the provider is working with.
      Parameters:
      providerName - - The full name of the provider addon with its package.
      generatorName - - Name of the provider's generator.
      filterListener - - The listener to whom the generator filters will be transmitted when they are updated.
      settingsListener - - The listener to whom the generator settings will be transmitted when they are updated.
